content_sections.heading: About TMB
content_sections.text: Tamilnad Mercantile Bank Ltd. describes itself in the notice as one of the leading old Private Sector Banks, on a high growth path. This post will head its Global NRI Centre work, covering NRI customers, global remittance services and tie-ups with international banks.

rows.pay: As applicable to Deputy Vice President

content_sections.heading: TMB Global NRI Centre Head Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: Check the official notification (PDF) for the full eligibility conditions of this post.

rows.details: Minimum 40 years and not more than 50 years as on 30.09.2026
In deserving cases the age may be relaxed
Any Graduate / Post Graduate from a recognized university under regular curriculum
Ten years of work experience in Banking and handling NRI business, out of which five years of experience in supervisory or managerial cadre
No vigilance case or adverse observation from RBI / Statutory Authority shall be pending against the candidate identified for appointment

content_sections.heading: Roles and Responsibilities
content_sections.text: Provide tailored and efficient banking solutions for a superior customer experience. Identify new business opportunities and expand the bank's NRI customer base. Build a specialised team with expertise in NRI requirements, global remittance services and regulatory compliance. Build and maintain strong relationships with High Net Worth NRI clients and meet their banking needs. Ensure banking operations comply with RBI guidelines, FEMA regulations and international banking norms. Understand each client's financial goals, risk tolerance and investment horizon to offer tailored solutions. Organise events, webinars and promotional campaigns for NRI products. Collaborate with international banks and financial institutions on tie-up arrangements. Stay up to date on regulatory changes in NRI transactions and compliance requirements. Develop marketing strategies and work with internal teams on sales, trading and other portfolio management. Promote NRI products such as NRE/NRO accounts, remittance services and loans. Take on any other role assigned by the Bank.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The Bank will scrutinise the e-applications and shortlist candidates, who then appear for a personal interview. The interview will be held through Direct / Video Conferencing, and the mode, date and time will be communicated to eligible candidates individually. The Bank may eliminate ineligible candidates at any point before, during or after the interview, and its decision on eligibility, interview and selection is final.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: Tenor: regular basis. Rank: Deputy Vice President. Place of posting: Ernakulam, Kerala. Transfer: the job role and location are subject to transfer based on requirements.

content_sections.text: Have a valid personal email ID and contact number before you start, and keep them active until the recruitment is complete. faq.question: Q1. Can I apply by post or in person?
faq.answer: No. The Bank accepts applications only through its online careers portal, and no other mode of submission is accepted.

faq.question: Q2. Is the Global NRI Centre Head post on contract?
faq.answer: No. The notice gives the tenor as "Regular basis".

faq.question: Q3. Can the posting change from Ernakulam?
faq.answer: Yes, it can. The first posting is at Ernakulam, but the job role and location are subject to transfer based on requirements.

faq.question: Q4. Can a candidate above 50 be considered?
faq.answer: Possibly. The upper limit is 50 years as on 30 September 2026, but the notice says the age may be relaxed in deserving cases.

faq.question: Q5. Which document can I use as age proof?
faq.answer: Upload a self-attested photocopy of your SSLC or Higher Secondary Mark Sheet / Transfer Certificate.

faq.question: Q6. How will I know if I am shortlisted?
faq.answer: Shortlisted applicants will be told individually by post or e-mail, with details of the interview.

faq.question: Q7. Can I sign in capital letters?
faq.answer: No. A signature in capital letters shall not be accepted.

faq.question: Q8. What can lead to disqualification?
faq.answer: Canvassing in any form is a disqualification. A pending vigilance case or adverse observation from RBI or a Statutory Authority also bars the candidate identified for appointment.
